caption: Per-field wavefront error at 0, 1.5′ and 3′, the three-conic limit against the freeform design (`tma_freeform_fields.png`).
number: Taken off axis by %pin:p2_tma_freeform_dec% m to clear its beams, the three-conic design reaches %pin:p2_tma_freeform_lim% waves at its worst field over ±3′; freeform departures on M2 and M3, every radius and conic held, take it to %pin:p2_tma_freeform_ff% waves.
